en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a woman in a trench coat standing on a sidewalk beside a row of parked 1950s-era cars. Behind her are partially damaged or rough-rendered building walls and, further back, modernist mid-rise office or apartment buildings with large windows. A tree frames the right side and a utility truck is parked to the left. The image has the composition and framing typical of a vintage urban postcard.
